collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: A visitor asks a villager with no single job what they do: say a bit of everything, or say you are still working it out.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A visitor at the fire is going round asking everyone what they do. "I'm a builder." "I'm a fisher." "I'm a healer." The visitor turns to (name1). (name1) does a bit of everything. A bit of gardening, a bit of fishing, some carrying, some childminding. (He/she) has never had a single answer, and (he/she) is suddenly afraid it sounds like nothing.

choices.label: Say It's a Bit of Everything

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "A bit of everything," says (name1). The visitor looks interested. "That sounds useful." Somebody else chimes in: "(name1)'s the one we all go to when something needs doing." (name1) is startled. (He/she) had never thought of it that way. (He/she) thinks about it all evening.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "I'm still working that out," says (name1), with a smile. The visitor laughs. "Me too. I'm forty." The fire laughs with them, warmly. (name1) realizes (he/she) isn't the only one. Several people, later, quietly admit that they're not sure either.
